children: Korn Ferry reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $764.62M and diluted earnings per share of $1.32, compared with $715.54M and $1.26 in the prior-year quarter, reflecting broad regional growth and gains across its solutions.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share attributable to Korn Ferry”.
Fee revenue rose 7% year over year to $756.5M, driven by broad regional growth and double-digit gains in Search and Workforce.
Reporting was reorganized into three Regions and three Solution groups (Search, Talent & Org, Workforce) to better align delivery with client buying patterns.
Marquee/Diamond program expanded to 350 accounts, representing roughly 40% of fee revenue, indicating deeper strategic client partnerships.
Company increased investment in integration, marketing and severance as it scales and integrates acquisitions such as AMS.
